cause_evidence: [  1018.067] (WW) NVIDIA(GPU-0): The EDID read for display device DP-2 is invalid:
[  1018.067] (WW) NVIDIA(GPU-0): - The EDID has a bad detailed timing descriptor.

/etc/systemd/system/waveshare-edid.servi.content:
[Unit]
Description=Repair the known WaveShare EDID on NVIDIA DP-2
After=systemd-modules-load.service
Before=display-manager.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/libexec/waveshare-edid-prepare.py
TimeoutStartSec=15

/etc/udev/rules.d/90-waveshare-edid.rule.content:
# Recheck monitor identity on DRM hotplug; the service changes only its matching EDID.
ACTION=="change", SUBSYSTEM=="drm", KERNEL=="card[0-9]*", RUN+="/usr/bin/systemctl --no-block start waveshare-edid.service"

/etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/99-waveshare-edid.c.content:
# Generated for the verified malformed WaveShare EDID.
Section "OutputClass"
    Identifier "waveshare-known-edid"
    MatchDriver "nvidia-drm"
    Option "CustomEDID" "DFP-2:/usr/local/share/waveshare-display/edid-fixed.bin"
EndSection
